title: Bands traveling in cars
summary: Some bands, perhaps Andy Kirk's, traveled in cars with one instrument truck.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Was the private car really that much better than the bus?
Well, some -- some bands traveled in cars. They didn't have a bus. They just had four or five cars, and you traveled in cars. Of course, like that it

wasn't too bad because you could change drivers. You know, you could switch off, one guy drive, another guy doze a while. Several bands back in that day traveled like that. That's how they'd get -- they might have one truck that carried instruments and four, five cars that the guys rode in.
Do you know whose band traveled in cars?

I think -- I'm not sure. I think Andy Kirk traveled like that. There was one of the bands that traveled -- but I know several did, back in those times, you know. If you pick up some of the old jazz books, you see some of the pictures of cars, those old cars where they were traveling in the cars, you know, some of them.
